449:t_1:86.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But is there really a $$バスターマシン$$ on the far side of the Moon...?」

449:t_1:87.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Oh, it's definitely there. In the confusion over $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$, I slipped into the $$ムーンレィス$$' data bank and checked.」

449:t_1:89.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It was to find $$トラントロワ$$. It couldn't be helped.」

449:t_1:90.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$トラントロワ$$... So that's the name of that $$バスターマシン$$.」

449:t_1:91.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's a machine everyone thought sank twenty years ago, in the Second Battle of the Kuiper Belt.」

449:t_1:92.en:
$$カシオ$$
「There are a few other machines like it, you know. I've been tracking down where they ended up on my own.」

449:t_1:93.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And it's on the far side of the Moon...」

449:t_1:94.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Probably an effect of the $$時空震動$$. Even I was surprised to find it near $$メガネビュラ$$.」

449:t_1:95.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Well... if things weren't this chaotic, there's no way we could get into an area the $$ムーンレィス$$ manage.」

449:t_1:97.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Let's go. $$トラントロワ$$ must be waiting for us.」

449:t_2:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A $$バスターマシン$$... But it's broken...」

449:t_2:8.en:
$$カシオ$$
「You can still fight. Together with me, like that day.」

449:t_2:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What!? $$カシオ$$'s going to pilot it!?」

449:t_2:10.en:
$$カシオ$$
「There was a time I thought a $$バスターマシン$$ suited a kid like you best.」

449:t_2:11.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I thought it would be happiness, both for you and for the $$バスターマシン$$...」

449:t_2:12.en:
$$カシオ$$
「But it isn't. Riding a $$バスターマシン$$ is a terrifying thing. Once you ride one, your heart gets held captive.」

449:t_2:14.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Is it really something you need right now...? I don't think so, and neither does $$ラルク$$...」

449:t_2:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Are you saying Big Sis thinks $$ノノ$$ doesn't need a $$バスターマシン$$...!?」

449:t_2:16.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I think what $$ラルク$$ wants from you is something else entirely...」

449:t_2:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「But all we have is $$バスターマシン$$s! If we lose that power, we can't even find a reason to live! That $$ノノリリ$$ must be the same, I'm sure of it!」

449:t_2:19.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I don't want to fool myself anymore! I pretended I'd reached $$あがり$$ and hid who I really am all this time, but I'm still $$トップレス$$!」

449:t_2:21.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Let's do this, $$トラントロワ$$! Our new fight starts from this very moment! $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!」

449:t_2:23.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!!」

449:t_2:24.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!!!!!!」

449:t_2:26.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...I knew it... It's no good...」

449:t_2:27.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I knew it all along... that I reached $$あがり$$ a long, long time ago...」

449:t_2:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I can hear Big Sis's voice...」

449:t_2:31.en:
$$カシオ$$
「What are you talking about...? No matter how full of Ether this place is, there's no way the fighting on the other side of the Moon reaches it.」

449:t_2:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But I can hear it! Big Sis's voice, calling for help!!」

449:t_3:3.en: ～ $$トップレス$$ $$タイタン$$ Base: $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$' Room ～

449:t_3:4.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「...$$ニコラス・バセロン$$ has sent over some interesting data again.」

449:t_3:5.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「We can't say that thing's activation is unrelated, either.」

449:t_3:6.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「As I thought, the livelier ones probably work better, don't you think?」

449:t_3:7.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Right. Since it's come to this, let's have more and more of their friends come to the Solar System.」

449:t_3:8.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「And when that thing awakens...」

449:t_3:9.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Surely, with that power, we'll obtain eternity...」

449:t_3:12.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Soon this dinner will be a full course, too.」

449:t_3:13.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Then let's dig in, praying for our future.」

449:t_3:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「She's back to the old $$ノノ$$!」

449:t_3:21.en:
$$チコ$$
「What in the world is that $$バスターマシン７号$$ thing!?」

449:t_3:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「So in the end, that Solar System-limited kind isn't our enemy, is it!?」

449:t_3:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「Or rather, is it on the side of $$ノノ$$'s sis!?」

449:t_3:24.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Aah...! If you all say so much at once, $$ノノ$$'s head is going to blow!」

449:t_3:25.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then explain it properly so everyone can understand.」

449:t_3:29.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ doesn't really get it either.」

449:t_3:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ah, it hurts my feelings when you put it like that...」

449:t_3:33.en:
$$チコ$$
「Honestly... Have you ever heard the phrase 'you brought it on yourself'?」

449:t_3:34.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But you can't just say that to me...」

449:t_3:35.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「For now, tell us in order. You were on the Moon, right?」

449:t_3:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes. I went to look for a $$バスターマシン$$ with $$カシオ$$ on the far side of the Moon, but...」

449:t_3:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then I heard Big Sis's voice, and when I came to, I was in that place.」

449:t_3:38.en:
$$甲児$$
「I hear $$カシオ$$'s on his way here too, but he says $$ノノ$$ seems to have warped...」

449:t_3:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「So your hidden power awakened to save $$ラルク$$ from danger, huh!」

449:t_3:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! That's it! That's exactly it!!」

449:t_3:41.en:
$$ノノ$$
「To save Big Sis from her plight, $$ノノ$$ finally reveals her true form...! It's truly the comeback of a champion of justice!」
